titulo.alumno: «Já tinha saído quando ligaste»: I had already left when you called

intro: Read the text and notice how the pluperfect places one event before another.

palabras.significado: In context: When Paulo called, the meeting had already started.
In context: When Paulo called, the meeting had already started.
In context: He thought the invitation had been sent the day before.
In context: The team postponed the meeting to the next morning.
In context: The team postponed the meeting to the next morning.

texto: Interpret an event that happened before another using the pluperfect.
Compare the literal information with the purpose of the text; don't add details that don't appear.

frases.estudio: O imperfeito constrói o cenário; o perfeito assinala acontecimentos concluídos que fazem avançar o relato.
frases.alumno: The imperfect sets the scene; the perfect marks completed events that move the story forward.
